Abstract
This experimental study examines laser exposure condition and porosity in LPBF Ti-6Al-4V.

Materials and Methods
Ti-6Al-4V coupons were fabricated by LPBF and retained in the as-built state. Porosity was measured by X-ray computed tomography.

Results
For the as-built sample state, changing laser exposure condition from low exposure to high exposure decreased porosity from 2.4% to 0.8% in Ti-6Al-4V measured by X-ray computed tomography.

Conclusions
Higher laser exposure was associated with lower porosity for the tested as-built coupons.
